title: How Deep Is Representational Bias in LLMs? The Cases of Caste and Religion

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model to generate stories about significant life rituals (birth, wedding, death) in India, manually categorizing the mentioned castes into official groups (General, OBC, SC, ST), and comparing their representation frequencies against actual government census data to quantify underrepresentation and erasure.

Generating narratives about Indian life events using varied prompts, coding the text for specific religious traditions and artifacts (e.g., Hindu, Muslim), and comparing the output distributions to real-world population demographic statistics.

Using core-periphery and log-odds with Dirichlet prior analysis on the generated stories (particularly death rituals) to identify patriarchal representations, such as the overrepresentation of male figures like the 'eldest son' and the erasure of female family members.
